desc: The highly sought-after Stevens 334 Trigger was designed for dedicated hunters who demand top quality. The trigger's pull weight is set at 3 lbs. from the factory and can be adjusted between 2 and 4 lbs., allowing you to experience a crisp, smooth pull at your preferred weight. All trigger components are precisely machined to maintain tight tolerances, heat-treated for durability, and coated with premium finishes to resist weather and wear. The Stevens 334 Trigger is built to provide reliable performance for a lifetime and will perform consistently even in the harshest conditions.
